# HTMLP 0.2

Token limits for prompt files. Typed Rust prompts and categorized usage for agent context and skills.

Use prompt files, Rust runtime types, or both. Current release: v0.2.0-alpha.4.
CLI: cargo install --git https://github.com/alexmckenley/htmlp --tag v0.2.0-alpha.4 --features cli
Rust: htmlp = { git = "https://github.com/alexmckenley/htmlp", tag = "v0.2.0-alpha.4", features = ["runtime"] }
Add tokens for Cl100k. No default features; runtime includes json, not tokenizer tables.

Save as .htmlp:
<htmlp max-tokens="1k" reason="Shared context.">
<section id="workflow">Make one change. Test it.</section>
</htmlp>

Sign intentional budgets: htmlp sign ./prompts
Check: htmlp check ./prompts
Every declared max-tokens or per-item requires a nonblank reason on that element.
sig hashes local limits and reason; check rejects missing/stale signatures.
Content edits do not need re-signing. Do not automatically sign in CI.
Signatures are checksums, not approvals; editors can re-sign unchanged reasons.
Each file is independent; no external configuration or directory inheritance.
1k = 1000 tokens. Default encoding: cl100k_base, not a universal model tokenizer.
Use section IDs for lookup. Variables use {{name}}, with no limits or attributes.
Repeated variable names reuse a binding. Empty elements may self-close.
Escape literal < and & in Markdown. Unknown markup fails.
Static checks defer variable-dependent budgets (tokens: null, deferred: true).
render substitutes literal bindings and checks final file and section budgets.
Inline limits and reasons are editable; policy changes need review.

Runtime feature: attributed fragments, model requests, explicit estimates, reported usage.
PromptFragment::text(source, role, text); ModelRequest::builder(model).fragment(fragment).build().
ContentSource categories: SystemPrompt, ContextBlock{block_id}, ToolDefinitions, UserMessage,
SessionMessage, AssistantHistory, ToolOutput{tool_name}, SystemReminder{origin}, Hook{hook_name}, CompactionSummary.
Role is independently System, User, or Assistant. Your provider adapter sends requests.
request.estimate(): UTF-8 bytes grouped by full source, rounded up at 4 bytes/token; 8192 tokens/image.
ByteEstimator policy is configurable. Estimates exclude provider framing and do not enforce context capacity.
TokenUsage separates optional estimate and optional reported usage; unavailable is None, not zero.
Reported input excludes cache reads/writes; prompt_tokens adds all three. Reasoning is part of output.
merge_snapshot takes maxima within one call; add_call sums distinct calls.
render_checked returns immutable text, measurements, and section provenance.
PromptFragment::checked(source, role, &rendered) bridges checked text into a request.
section(id) selects only after the entire document passes. Do not sum overlapping budget measurements.
No category attributes in markup yet.
